english.default: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

english.text: aasaa mahalaa 5 |

english.text: sarab dookh jab bisareh suaamee |

english.text: eehaa aoohaa kaam na praanee |1|

english.text: sant tripataase har har dhayaae |

english.default: Bestowing Your Mercy, God, You attach us to Your Name; all peace comes by Your Will. ||Pause||

english.text: kar kirapaa apunai naae laae sarab sookh prabh tumaree rajaae | rahaau |

english.default: The Lord is Ever-present; one who deems Him to be far away,

english.text: sang hovat kau jaanat door |

gurmukhi.unicode: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮਰਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥

english.default: Dies again and again, repenting. ||2||

english.text: so jan marataa nit nit jhoor |2|

english.default: The mortals do not remember the One, who has given them everything.

english.text: jin sabh kichh deea tis chitavat naeh |

english.text: mahaa bikhiaa meh din rain jaeh |3|

english.default: Says Nanak, meditate in remembrance of the One Lord God.

english.text: kahu naanak prabh simarahu ek |

english.default: Salvation is obtained, in the Shelter of the Perfect Guru. ||4||3||97||

english.text: gat paaeeai gur poore ttek |4|3|97|
